_note: Episode 40 (Season 4) keyframes (from Kabanata 40, story version 2). The arks are giant wooden balangay (planks joined with dowels and lashings), built in open shipyards with posted receipts (no readable text). God is never shown; the coming water is a dark sea, not a divine image. Indio is 41, a few grey hairs; no seals, flags or logos of any real office. The allies are the story's folklore figures, friendly. Copied from Episode 13: full intro. Shots follow sentences.json; k90+ are montage extras.
